summary: Ocugen, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the completion of a $115.0 million private offering of 6.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2034 issued under an indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, N.A. as trustee. The notes are unsecured, rank senior to subordinated debt, and mature May 15, 2034. Interest is payable semi-annually starting November 15, 2026. Conversion is cash-settled until a reserved share effective date, subject to Nasdaq Exchange Cap of 67,629,947 shares pending stockholder approval. No premium, acquisition, or strategic event; this is a financing transaction. Watch for stockholder vote on share issuance and potential dilution management.
